title: Hatsune Miku — An Evolving Tone〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are!
I'm sorry to bother you during practice like this, Miku, but can I borrow you for a second?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO. Luka too? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We just received a pleasant little invitation and thought that we should tell you as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An invitation?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Saki and the girls just invited us to a picnic to see the cherry blossoms during their next day off.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They even said that all the cherry blossoms are in full bloom right now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Cherry blossoms...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means you two finally get to see the cherry blossoms at that park too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait... Have you already gone and seen them, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I did, with Ichika.
They were incredible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aww, that's so nice! I can't wait to see them! But I hope it doesn't rain...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Rain?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The forecast apparently said that it might rain that day, but Saki said everything would be okay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rain makes the cherry blossoms lose their petals faster, so I hope it stays clear...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Me too...
A few days later

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
You did great today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Phew...
Thanks for helping us out too, Miku, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And tomorrow's the day of the picnic.
Are you sure it won't rain?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The forecast hasn't changed much since then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I was looking forward to seeing the cherry blossoms with Luka and MEIKO...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
The rain's definitely gonna go away as long as we have these...! Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are those weather charms...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sort of, but they're all sparkly for some reason. It's like they really want attention or something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We used the leftover cloths and fabrics that Tsukasa was using to make costumes and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I made my very own, one-of-a-kind lucky weather charm!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, look! the pigtails on this one are similar to yours, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: One piece of cloth had a color that was pretty close, so I decided to make this one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I brought some of the stuff we used to make these, so wanna try making some more together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure. I'd like to try.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How about you, Honami? Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Just one or two.
Will you join us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, if it's just one...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to as well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, take your pick!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... So many colors... Some are very vibrant and others less so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're right... Oh!
This has the same color as Luka's hair!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And this has the same checkerboard pattern as what she's wearing too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I'm set...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you making one based off Luka?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would that be okay, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course. Just make me look cute, alright?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I will.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The cherry blossoms I saw with Ichika the other day were so beautiful. I really want Luka and MEIKO to see them too.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I have to make this right so that they can...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And done...! My lucky Luka charm!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I just finished mine too.
Mine's a Shibao charm!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so cute!
It has ears just like a dog!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! It's so adorable!
And I expect nothing less from someone in the home ec club. It's so well made!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How's it going for you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I went for more of a rock and roll look...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like it's wearing a black leather outfit covered in pin badges...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! All that's left to do is hang them up and it's definitely be sunny tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see the cherry blossoms with them. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I've been a little concerned about Shiho too, so I'm glad the girls will have an opportunity to just have fun together.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm counting on you, lucky Luka charm...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It turned out this cute, so I'm sure it'll be nice out tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree! Plus, we can wait until then together♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah.
